District will be the new Realm[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://us.v-cdn.net/6030815/uploads/0IH7L0TFKVNZ/bar-white.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]NEW SURVIVOR: KWON TAE-YOUNG[/b][/h3][p align="start"][b]New Survivor Perks:[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]Flow State[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever a generator is completed, earn [b]1[/b] token, up to [b]5[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]For each token:[/p][list][*][p]You bless and cleanse Totems [b]8/9/10%[/b] faster.[/p][/*][*][p]You heal [b]8/9/10%[/b] faster.[/p][/*][*][p]You unhook Survivors [b]8/9/10%[/b] faster.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]A Place For Us[/b][/p][list][*][p]While healing another Survivor, you both gain [b]Elusive[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you finish healing The Obsession, you both gain [b]Elusive [/b]for [b]20/25/30[/b]s.[/p][/*][*][p]When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Five Moves Ahead[/b][/p][list][*][p]While you are in the Killer's Terror radius or chased by the Killer:[/p][list][*][p]You see the Auras of the [b]5[/b] closest Pallets and Windows.[/p][/*][*][p]After you drop a Pallet, you start moving [b]50%[/b] earlier.[/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you drop a Pallet, cooldown: [b]40/35/30[/b]s.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="https://us.v-cdn.net/6030815/uploads/ZE9EAMMKMH3D/bar-red.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]GAMEPLAY FEATURES[/b][/h2][h3][b]Killer Updates[/b][/h3][p align="start"][b]Killer Update - The Trickster[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]Summary[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Trickster now gains Style Points by throwing Blades, injuring Survivors and performing distinct gameplay actions back-to-back[/p][/*][*][p]The Trickster goes up in Style Ranks by earning Style Points.[/p][/*][*][p]Each Style Rank improves The Trickster's Blade throw rate and Locker Restocking speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Main Event can now only be activated once reaching the highest Style Rank.[/p][/*][*][p]Style Points and Style Ranks are tracked via a new user interface element custom-made for The Trickster.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Basekit[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Trickster's movement speed decreased to [b]4.4m/s[/b] [i](was 4.6 m/s)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Blade count decreased to [b]36 [/b][i](was 44)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased Terror Radius to [b]24m [/b][i](was 32m)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased time to enter Throw State to [b]0.3s [/b][i](was 0.35s)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased time to exit Throw State to [b]1.15s[/b] [i](was 1.25s)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased time between Blade throws to [b]0.33s[/b] [i](was 0.3s)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased base Throw State movement speed to [b]3.86m/s [/b][i](was 3.68m/s)[/i].[/p][list][*][p]After [b]5 [/b]consecutive Blade throws, Throw State movement speed is decreased to[b] 3.53 m/s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]After [b]10[/b] consecutive Blade throws, Throw State movement speed is decreased to [b]3.16 m/s[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Increase Blade throw rate per Blade thrown:[/p][list][*][p]After [b]5[/b] consecutive Blade throws, the throw rate increased by [b]50%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]After [b]10[/b] consecutive Blade throws, the throw rate is increased by [b]100%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Laceration[/b][/p][list][*][p]Laceration now only counted using whole numbers [i](previously decayed into decimals)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Laceration Meter decreased to [b]6[/b] [i](was 8)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Laceration Meter decay delay decreased to [b]12s[/b] [i](was 15s)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increase Laceration stack decay time to [b]4.4s[/b] [i](was 3s)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Laceration visual feedback updated.[/p][list][*][p]Now displayed on the Survivor directly, for both Survivors and Killer.[/p][/*][*][p]Laceration cuts removed from Survivors' user interface.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Style Points[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Trickster performing combo actions generates Style Points.[/p][list][*][p]A combo action is triggered when two back-to-back gameplay actions are distinct.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The following actions generate [b]1 Style Point[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Hitting a Survivor with a Blade [i](first-hit only).[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Injuring a Survivor [i](from Laceration or basic-attack).[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Hooking a Survivor.[/p][/*][*][p]Basic-breaking a Downed Pallet.[/p][/*][*][p]Basic-breaking a Breakable Wall.[/p][/*][*][p]Damaging a Generator.[/p][/*][*][p]Snuffing a Boon Totem.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The following actions generate [b]2 Style Points[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Hitting a Survivor with [b]4[/b] Blades from at least [b]4m [/b][i](without missing or exiting the Throw State).[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Hitting a Survivor with a Blade from more than [b]16m [/b]away.[/p][/*][*][p]Interrupting a Survivor.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The following actions generate [b]3 Style Points[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Hitting a Survivor with a Blade through small gaps.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Style Ranks[/b][/p][list][*][p]There are 6 Style Ranks: E, D, C, B, A and S-Rank.[/p][/*][*][p]Style Ranks each have their respective bonus maximum throw rate and Locker restocking speed modifiers.[/p][list][*][p]Higher bonuses at higher ranks.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Higher Style Ranks require more Style Points to reach.[/p][/*][*][p]Higher Style Ranks feature progressively shorter combo timers.[/p][list][*][p]Ranks regress to previous in order if combo timer ever lapses.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Earning Style Points refreshes the current Style Rank's combo timer.[/p][/*][*][p]Style Rank combo timers are paused while The Trickster is performing interactions with Survivors or interactable objects.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]S-Rank[/b][/p][list][*][p]When reaching of S-Rank[/p][list][*][p]Survivors within [b]44m[/b] of The Trickster are revealed via Killer Instinct for [b]4.4s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]All Survivors are notified across the Trial.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]While in S-Rank:[/p][list][*][p]The Trickster gains a [b]44m [/b]Terror radius.[/p][/*][*][p]Lullaby is disabled.[/p][/*][*][p]Laceration Meters decay [b]50%[/b] slower.[/p][/*][*][p]Blade throw and Locker restock speeds increased to maximum.[/p][/*][*][p]Main Event can be activated.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]S-Rank has a [b]66s [/b]combo timer.[/p][list][*][p]S-Rank [b]cannot[/b] be paused or refreshed [i](unlike lower Style Ranks)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]S-Rank [b]always [/b]reverts to E-Rank [i](via timer, or once Main Event ends)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Main Event[/b][/p][list][*][p]Press the Secondary Ability button to activate Main Event[/p][list][*][p]Main Event lasts [b]10s[/b] [i](was 8s).[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Main Event movement speed set at [b]3.92 m/s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The Trickster throws Blades at at [b]1.67x[/b] the default Blade throw speed.[/p][list][*][p][i]Note: not affected by Consecutive Blade Throw and Style Rank Blade Throw modifiers.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Survivors near The Trickster are notified.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]While performing Main Event:[/p][list][*][p]S-Rank timer is paused.[/p][/*][*][p]Each Blade hitting Survivors awards bonus Style Points.[/p][/*][*][p]The Trickster can cancel Main Even via the Secondary Ability button.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]When Main Event ends:[/p][list][*][p]The Trickster's Power goes on cooldown for [b]4s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]S-Rank resets to E-Rank[/p][/*][*][p]The Trickster goes up in Style Ranks over time, based on bonus Style Points earned during Main Event.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]The Trickster's Add-Ons[/b][/p][list][*][p]Memento Blades [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Displays[/b] a reticle while aiming with Blades.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Trick Pouch [/p][list][*][p][b]Increases[/b] maximum carried [b]Blades[/b] by [b]4[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Start the Trial with [b]4[/b] extra [b]Blades[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Killing Part Chords [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Increases[/b] time before Style Ranks from D to A decay by [b]20%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Inferno Wires [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Decreases[/b] Showstopper's cooldown after Main Event by [b]44%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ji-Woon's Throw Speed by [b]8% [/b]for[b] 8 seconds.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Gain 3%[/b] Haste for [b]3 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gain[/b] an additional Style Point.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Caged Heart Shoes [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p]When you basic-break Pallets and Breakable Walls or damage Generators, the next time you enter the Throw State, increase movement speed while in the Throw State by[b] 5%[/b] for [b]10 seconds[/b]. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Tequila Moonrock [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Increases[/b] Throw Speed by [b]15%[/b] for [b]10 [/b]faster.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Melodious Murder[/p][list][*][p][b]Increases Blade[/b] reload speed at lockers by [b]25%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Diamond src="https://us.v-cdn.net/6030815/uploads/9L7K119Y76IK/bar-white.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Killer Actions Update[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Accompanying the new language found in the Perks Description Update (see below), we have expanded our distinction between basic and special actions performed by Killers.[/p][/*][*][p]Starting in update 9.5.0, the following terms will now appear in Power, Add-on and Perk descriptions:[/p][list][*][p][b]Basic-break[/b][/p][list][*][p]When a Pallet or Breakable Wall is broken by the default ability of any Killer.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Special-break[/b][/p][list][*][p]When a Downed Pallet or Breakable Wall is broken due to an ability granted by a Killer's Window or Downed Pallet is vaulted due to an ability granted by a Killer's Power.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Damaging Generators[/b][/p][list][*][p]When a Generator is damaged and loses progress due to the default ability of any Killer.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Generator Explosions[/b][/p][list][*][p]When a Generator loses progress due to an ability granted by a Killer's Power or Perk.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]With these new terms, we intend to express with increased accuracy when specific gameplay interactions are intended to work alongside one
